description: Lists the chart and table datasets on the statistics page (id, title, topic, section, row count) with their download addresses: the CSV and JSON of the whole page, one SVG per chart, the screening-test JSON and the changelog JSON. Pass an id (for example chart-1, table-2) to get that dataset's rows with their values, notes and reference keys.
